Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Manoj - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 25 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sonali - 30 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Manoj, what's the plan today?"

[Manoj nearly dies laughing at the joke.]

Manoj: "Really?"

[Manoj laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Manoj: "Meenakshi, listen!"

Scene 2: The fields - Day

[Manoj stands in the fields. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[A cobra bites Manoj and he dies in the fields.]

Meenakshi: "We have to be strong now."
